provenance.paper_title: Open Scene Graphs for Open World Object-Goal Navigation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Open Scene Graphs retain and organize open-set scene information during object-goal navigation. LLM reasoning and pathfinding query/use the OSG for object-goal navigation; explicit retrieval is partial.
During operation, Open Scene Graphs applies LLM-mediated memory editing to topo-semantic open-set scene information; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Open Scene Graphs applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to topo-semantic open-set scene information; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (topo-semantic open-set scene information) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
